title: 2019 Nord Sesta SV
longDescription: A small but lively hot hatch that feels quick, nimble, and easy to control. The Sesta SV is a great choice for players who want sharp handling, decent speed, and a fun lightweight car that is easy to throw through traffic.

title: 2019 Slovagen Ball GTR V8
longDescription: The Slovagen GTR is a strong all-rounder that mixes everyday usability with sporty performance. It offers more power and stability than smaller hot hatches, making it a dependable choice for players who want a fast but well-balanced car.

title: 2014 Sazda FX5 Shiatto
longDescription: A lightweight rear-wheel-drive roadster that focuses on agility and driver feel rather than raw power. The FX5 is an ideal starter car because it is predictable, fun to drive, and teaches the player how to handle corners and traffic smoothly.

title: 2025 DMV 365e
longDescription: The DMV 365e delivers strong turbocharged performance in a more refined and premium package. It feels stable at speed, has solid acceleration, and suits players who want a comfortable but still sporty car for longer, faster runs.

title: 2023 DOJ Challenge RST Hellbunny
longDescription: The DOJ Challenge RST Hellbunny is a loud and aggressive muscle car built around raw power and straight-line speed. It feels heavy, wild, and intimidating, making it a great choice for players who want a car that launches hard and dominates with brute force.

title: 2015 Solaren 660z
longDescription: A brutal supercar built for speed, precision, and excitement. The Solaren 660z combines huge power with a relatively light body, making it a dangerous but rewarding machine for players who can handle very high speeds and rapid reactions.

title: 2015 Lambini Uragan
longDescription: The Uragan is a dramatic high-performance supercar with a powerful V10 engine and aggressive character. It offers massive speed and strong presence, making it perfect for players who want a loud, flashy, and thrilling car at the top end of the garage.

title: 2015 Ferrati 460
longDescription: The Ferrati 460 is a sharp and responsive supercar known for its high-revving engine and precise performance. It feels fast, special, and highly rewarding, making it a top-tier choice for players who want speed with classic Italian style.

title: 2010 Sedecrem STR Solaren
longDescription: The Sedecrem STR Solaren is a German Supercar.

title: 2024 Ferrati SFX900 Strattalius
longDescription: The Ferrati SFX900 Strattalius is an elite hybrid supercar built for extreme speed and instant acceleration. Its advanced power delivery makes it feel sharp, futuristic, and brutally quick, making it a premium choice for players who want top-level performance and a high-tech driving feel.
